name: PunchPlay
description: Automatically track what you watch on PunchPlay. Scrobbles movies and TV episodes with full session tracking — start, pause, resume, and completion. Reads TMDB IDs directly from your Jellyfin library for reliable matching.

versions.changelog: Adds automatic access-token refresh with rotating refresh tokens, preserves links and queued scrobbles during transient refresh failures, and retries deliveries safely after refresh.
Stable release with per-user linking, Jellyfin username reporting, playback session tracking, pause/resume scrobbling, retry queueing, token-revocation cleanup, and admin diagnostics.
Reliability hardening release with background queue replay, force retry controls, improved auth/queue handling, session dedupe, and non-blocking live scrobble delivery.
Multi-user support release allowing each Jellyfin user to link their own PunchPlay account with scrobbles routed per user.
Final legacy single-user release with improved progress tracking interval and token revocation handling.
